description: This file defines the WordReportRenderer class responsible for generating Word documents (DOCX) reports using templates, including complex data like findings, attachments, revisions, and various project-related information. It utilizes PHPWord library for Word document manipulation and handles multiple embedded data sections and images.

classes.name: WordReportRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering Word report documents based on a template, inserting dynamic content, images, and converting markdown descriptions into HTML tables within the DOCX file. It manages complex sections like findings, attachments, user info, and revision history.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a Word document report by processing the template, inserting project data, findings, vulnerabilities, attachments, and other details, then saves the resulting file and records it as an attachment.

methods.name: replaceRowWithHtml
methods.description: Helper method that replaces a placeholder row in the Word template with HTML content formatted into a table, using PhpWord's HTML renderer.
